credits.overview: A police search disturbs the peace and quiet of a suburban family and arouses suspicions in Nicolas about his father Sylvain, a secret man with suspicious activities.

credits.overview: Two recently released prisoners learn to live in a sugar shack deep in the forest.

credits.title: La sphatte
credits.overview: Two red-clad women are pursued by an insistent, yet weary stranger. An existential stroll on the nocturnal pavement of a gloomy Montreal, carried by the sounds of punk rock music.

credits.title: Kosovolove
credits.overview: A couple's impasse is refracted through the world’s great tragedies, and the news of  "what is happening in Kosovo”. A tender, indifferent, cynical and bittersweet slice of melodrama.
